_about: The menus the order screen shows as tabs, and which of the export's categories each one sells. Food is the default: a category no other menu names is on it. A category named under two menus is on both (Beverages: with the food and at the bar). Lunch has hours; the others are open whenever the restaurant is. Tabs come in priority order, highest first. The bar's own shelves (bar.json) name their menu in that file. Edit and run `hubctl update`; a running hub takes the change with `hubctl menu import --apply`, which moves a category's section (and every dish in it) to the menu named here and leaves everything else as the menu editor has it.
